page_title: TOR 0-0 SAL | Torino v Salernitana 04/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Torino comes to nothing.

90+3' Pietro Pellegri (Torino) has a great chance on the edge of the six-yard box following a lofted pass, but his header lacks accuracy and flies just past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Salernitana.
90+2' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) takes a short corner kick.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Karol Linetty (Torino) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
87' A substitution has been made. Grigoris Kastanos is replaced by Emanuel Vignato (Salernitana).
81' The referee points to the corner flag and Salernitana will take a corner.
80' Here is a change. Saba Sazonov is going off and Ivan Juric gives the last tactical orders to Matteo Lovato (Torino).
80' Here's the change. Samuele Ricci leaves the pitch and Ivan Ilic (Torino) comes on as a substitute.
77' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) commits a rough challenge and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul.
73' Triantafyllos Pasalidis doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Junior Sambia (Salernitana) comes onto the pitch to replace him.
72' It doesn’t look good for Triantafyllos Pasalidis (Salernitana); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
70' Torino force a corner. They send men into the box.
67' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
65' Here comes a substitution. Koffi Djidji (Torino) is brought on as a substitute for Nikola Vlasic.
65' Ivan Juric decides to make a substitution. Adrien Tameze will be replaced by Pietro Pellegri (Torino).
64' Now Torino have a corner.
63' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) sends the corner into the box, but Guillermo Ochoa intercepts it and averts the threat.
63' A yellow-coloured card is received by Niccolo Pierozzi (Salernitana).
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Loum Tchaouna departs the field of play to be replaced by Boulaye Dia (Salernitana).
61' Filippo Inzaghi prepares a substitution. Jerome Boateng is replaced by Marco Pellegrino (Salernitana).
58' Torino take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
57' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The linesman points to the corner flag, Torino are going to take it.
56' The ball goes behind for a corner. Torino will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
52' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Torino.
51' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 0:0.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+3' Salernitana seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
43' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adam Masina (Torino) replaces Ricardo Rodriguez.
39' Dangerous play by Nikola Vlasic (Torino). Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul.
36' Triantafyllos Pasalidis (Salernitana) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
32' Torino take a short corner kick.
32' Samuele Ricci (Torino) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
28' Torino hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
26' Saba Sazonov (Torino) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
21' The percentage of ball possession is – 70:30.
19' Great teamplay by Salernitana as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
14' The Salernitana players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
13' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
11' The Torino players are exchanging some short passes.
9' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) picks up an injury.
5' Torino force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
2' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Daniele Chiffi is the one to supervise the game today.
